label: build core debug
command: cmake -G "MinGW Makefiles" -S . -B build/cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/cmake --target rust_core

label: build core release
command: cmake -G "MinGW Makefiles" -S . -B build/cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/cmake --target rust_core
